About Us

Welcome to NKB ENTERPRISES

NKB ENTERPRISES is a growing e-commerce business focused on bringing unique, quality and thoughtfully selected products to customers.

We are starting our journey with hand-painted products, home cleaning essentials, artificial plants and décor, stationery, kids' clothing and other useful lifestyle products.

Our product range will continue to grow as we discover more products that offer creativity, usefulness and value.

“Our goal is simple — to bring something useful, special and valuable to every customer.”
